column1: # Stitched galaxy stellar mass function: GAMA + SDSS
#       systematic spread used as the uncertainty estimate.
#   - Transition near log M* ~ 11.4. SDSS is downsampled to avoid it
#     dominating over GAMA at intermediate masses.
#   Original GAMA values (Driver+2022) reported in h70-units
#     equivalent to physical units at H0 = 70 km/s/Mpc (h70 = 1).
#   Original SDSS values (Bernardi+2018) reported in physical units
#   Both have been rescaled to h-units with h = 0.6774 (the value
#     M*  in units of h^-2 M_sun
#     Phi in units of h^3 Mpc^-3 dex^-1
#   source       : 'GAMA' or 'SDSS' indicating origin of each point
